lines.en: Victor, we need to sort this budget problem out before the client arrives. Somebody mixed up the numbers for the second quarter.
lines.pt: Victor, temos de resolver este problema do orçamento antes de o cliente chegar. Alguém misturou os números do segundo trimestre.

lines.en: I know. I looked the report over last night, and I could not figure out why the total was so high.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Revi o relatório ontem à noite e não consegui entender por que o total estava tão alto.

lines.en: Let me check the file. The finance team sent it yesterday, and they must have left some old figures in.
lines.pt: Deixe-me ver o arquivo. A equipe de finanças o enviou ontem, e devem ter deixado alguns números antigos.

lines.en: Good point. Can you print it out, please? I prefer to go through the pages with a pen in my hand.
lines.pt: Boa observação. Pode imprimir, por favor? Prefiro examinar as páginas com uma caneta na mão.

lines.en: Sure. Here it is. Look, this line is wrong, and we can not leave it like that. Can you work the total out again?
lines.pt: Claro. Aqui está. Olhe, esta linha está errada, e não podemos deixá-la assim. Pode calcular o total de novo?

lines.en: Give me ten minutes. If I round the small items off, the answer should be much closer to what we expected.
lines.pt: Me dê dez minutos. Se eu arredondar os itens pequenos, a resposta deve ficar bem mais próxima do que esperávamos.

lines.en: Meanwhile I will ring the finance office up and ask them to explain it.
lines.pt: Enquanto isso, vou ligar para o financeiro e pedir que expliquem.

lines.en: Do that. And please write the new date down, because the client asked us to hand the final version in by Friday.
lines.pt: Faça isso. E anote a nova data, porque o cliente pediu que entreguemos a versão final até sexta.

lines.en: Done. They say they will sort everything out by two o’clock, and they will send the corrected file over to us.
lines.pt: Pronto. Dizem que resolverão tudo até as duas e que nos enviarão o arquivo corrigido.

lines.en: Great. Then we can set the meeting room up, put the slides on the screen, and calm down.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Então podemos arrumar a sala de reuniões, colocar os slides na tela e nos acalmar.

lines.en: Agreed. I am glad we worked it out together, because it would have been a stressful afternoon alone.
lines.pt: Combinado. Fico feliz que tenhamos resolvido juntas, porque teria sido uma tarde estressante sozinha.

facts.label: resolver, organizar
facts.sub: Sort out pode ter o objeto no meio ou depois: sort the problem out. Com pronome, sempre no meio: sort it out. Serve para resolver ou arrumar algo.

facts.label: calcular, resolver
facts.sub: Work out pode ser calcular um valor ou encontrar uma solução. Com nome ou pronome: work the total out, work it out. Também vale para exercícios físicos.

pages.title: Let’s sort this out right now · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Tuesday in London. Dana arrives at the office early. The budget report has a problem. A client is coming at three. Her colleague Nina is already there. They walk into the meeting room.

“Nina, we need to sort this budget problem out before the client arrives. Somebody mixed up the numbers for the second quarter.” says Dana. “I know. I looked the report over last night, and I could not figure out why the total was so high.” says Nina. “Let me check the file. The finance team sent it yesterday, and they must have left some old figures in.” says Dana.
